faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MSETCL Wireman Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the MSETCL Wireman Apprentice recruitment is 06-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Wireman Apprentice?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for the Wireman Apprentice post in MSETCL.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the Wireman Apprentice post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Wireman Apprentice post is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Wireman Apprentice post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Wireman Apprentice post is 38 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Wireman Apprentice post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC and possess an NCVT ITI Wireman trade qualification (4 semesters) from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for MSETCL Wireman Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the Wireman Apprentice position?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on merit determined by SSC and ITI percentages, with category-wise reservation applied.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for MSETCL Wireman Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article.
